name: Kamiki Masaomi
source:
A slightly lewd guy with slightly below average grades.
While not being serious about the sudden increase in the number of little sisters, he claims he's a young man who's trying to be a good big brother.
While learning about his little sisters and listening to their worries, he becomes more attracted by them.
